dynamic_line: &They clearly do not understand you.  It seems they do not hear you either.

responses.text: [You pull off your backpack, and start to pull out items you deem worthy of trading.  The weaponmaster finally looks interested.]

yes: &The Weaponmaster seems to be tinkering on something, and completely ignores you as you approach.

no: &The Weaponmaster seems to be tinkering on something, but turns their chair to you as you approach.
